title: The Opening
chunks:
The Opening.
The wind carried the smell of rain across the valley. Urza Planeswalker watched the horizon in silence. Mishra's brother did not answer, and “nobody spoke,” he said. Rhûn was far, and Éowyn was farther. Terenas Menethil the Second ruled, but Henry the Eighth did not; see Part two and Chapter four. St. Anselm lit a lamp 🙂 at dusk!
